# What `pip install --require-hashes` installs into the Apprise environment in
# docker/Dockerfile: Apprise 2.0.1 with `all-plugins`, and everything it pulls in,
# each at one version and checked against these hashes (wheels for Linux, amd64
# and arm64, Python 3.13). Dependabot keeps it current; to rebuild it by hand,
# download the wheels for both platforms (pip download --only-binary=:all:
# --platform manylinux_2_28_x86_64 / manylinux_2_28_aarch64 --python-version 3.13)
# and hash them. pgpy is the exception: it has no wheel, so its source archive is
# hashed instead, and the Dockerfile lets pip build that one package (0.5.4, the
# last wheel, breaks against cryptography 50).
